newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank of China in $180 mln aviation loan.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China in $180 mln aviation loan.

text.p: Bank of China has signed an accord with the China Aviation Technology Import and Export Corp to provide 1.5 billion yuan ($180.7 million) in circulating loans for the rest of 1997, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

The loans will ensure capital support for the company's major projects and the interest rate will be in line with that set by the People's Bank of China, the central bank, bank vice-president Zhao Ange was quoted as saying.
The China Aviation Technology Import and Export Corp is one of 300 key state-owned enterprises identified as having priority in obtaining bank loans amid China's tight credit policy.
Since the corporation was set up in 1979, the Bank of China has granted it loans of about 10 billion yuan, Xinhua said.
